item.title: Fri Nov 6: METR finds Anthropic's A.I. speedup, OpenAI's Critical-rated GPT-6 Cyber, data center votes hit chip stocks
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast, Built In. Stories: METR's inside assessment of Anthropic's roughly 2x AI R&D speedup, redactions and internal models; Claude Personal Finance, enterprise DLP hooks, AP election data deal; OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber rated Critical, Firefox bugs and 948 Linux exploits; Images 2.6 adds GIFs; data centers lose 40 of 41 ballot measures, Nasdaq falls 5.5% and chip stocks slide; Pierre and Conductor follow-ups, Cat Wu joins OpenAI; Inkling 2 Small, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Cursor live apps, Perplexity Teammates, Notion shared memory; Stacks Project in Lean, AlphaEvolve, Nvidia Cosmos 3 and VFlash; quick hits.

item.title: Thu Nov 5: Grok Bot makes phone calls, midterm voters reject data centers, OpenAI buys Pierre
item.description: Sources: The Rundown. Stories: SpaceXSI's Grok Bot adds phone calls (users are caller of record); midterm voters back data center limits in 38 of 39 measures, NBC exit poll on AI, Goldman's capacity-freeze estimate; OpenAI acquires Pierre, Conductor joins Meta; Ricursive Ripple-65B, Tencent Hy4, Kimi K3.1 Pro; Pangram Image 1.0; tips on sketch-before-build prompting and comparing free AI tools; reader's AI family-letter archive.

item.title: Wed Nov 4: Siri AI opens to developers, Anthropic's $895B commitments, OpenAI hires Anthropic's hackers
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: Apple's Siri AI developer preview in iOS 27.3 betas; Anthropic's amended S-1 details (Q3 revenue, operating loss, $895B commitments, RSP warning) and Cat Wu's exit; OpenAI partners with Cathedral and reprices its bug bounty; CrowdStrike AI Kill Switch and acquisitions; Google ties Search to AI for K-12 accounts; ChatGPT usage numbers and LifeVal; caveats on MIT weight-editing result; DeepSeek on Huawei Ascend; quick hits.

item.title: Tue Nov 3: AI rewrites AI weights, Anthropic's IPO filing flags self-improvement, OpenAI's busy day
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI. Stories: MIT shows GPT-6 Astra improving models by editing weights directly; Anthropic's amended IPO prospectus, Q3 financials and RSI warning; Claude message threads beta and Claude Code game-rebuild refusals; GPT-6.2 Astra spotted in Codex; OpenAI LifeVal benchmark, Abu Dhabi deals, ChatGPT Chat and Work tabs merge; Grok Bot usage cuts; Marvell to acquire Lumentum for $115B; engineering notes from Copilot Cowork, Framer Harness 2, NVIDIA Cosmos, GitHub Enclaves; quick hits.

item.title: Mon Nov 2: OpenAI trims its funding round, data centers on the ballot, backdoored Claude Code extension
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: OpenAI reportedly cuts round to $20B as Big Tech capex strains cash flow and Anthropic credit outlook; midterm data center votes and OpenAI's 'compute campus' rebrand; Google Suncatcher runs Gemma in orbit; tampered Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace; agents raising their own spending caps; Anthropic misalignment and data-poisoning research; DeepSeek's open-source super-agent; Mythos 5.5 sighting, Claude Ultra plan, OpenAI usage changes, GPT-Rosalind-6; quick hits.

item.title: Fri Oct 30: Nvidia spy report, Anthropic IPO filing, Mistral Large 4 open weights
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, Built In. Stories: alleged Chinese asset near Jensen Huang; Anthropic files to go public, becomes SpaceX's top customer, launches Claude self-assessment; Mistral Large 4 weights and open-weight exploit risk; Sam Altman on many AIs vs one superintelligence; agent swarm leadership; quick hits.
